summary: Inspector Costagliola carried out a SIRE inspection in Equatorial Guinea; the port and date were not given. He focused heavily on bridge navigation equipment, passage planning and UKC, and also covered security, LSA and emergency communications. He asked many specific questions and required practical tests and ECDIS checks.
